title: kith-peer: Peer/receipt inbound handler
description:
What: Implement the Peer/receipt JMAP method handler in kith-peer — the inbound path where a peer confirms that a message we sent was delivered or read.

Algorithm:
1. Deserialize args into PeerReceiptArgs struct: { accountId: String, messageId: String, kind: String, at: String }
2. Validate kind is "delivered" or "read"; else JmapError::invalid_arguments
3. Validate messageId is valid ULID; else JmapError::invalid_arguments
4. Acquire store lock; call store.messages().get(&message_id) -> if None return JmapError::not_found
5. Verify the message was sent BY this mailbox TO the calling peer: msg.sender_user_id must equal owner_id AND msg.delivery_state must be Pending or Delivered (not Received, which is an inbound message); else JmapError::not_found (don't leak existence)
6. Match kind: "delivered" -> call store.messages().update_delivery_state(&id, &DeliveryState::Delivered, Some(now_unix)); "read" -> call store.messages().update_read_at(&id, now_unix)
7. Release store lock; return Ok(json!({ "accountId": "a-self", "accepted": true }))

Defensive rules:
- Validate kind enum before any DB lookup (step 2)
- Ownership check (step 5) MUST precede state update; a peer must not receipt someone else's message
- Return JmapError::not_found for all ownership failures (do NOT distinguish 'not found' vs 'wrong owner' in response — that leaks information)
- Never log message body; log only message_id
- DeliveryState transitions: Delivered after Received is nonsensical; guard against regressions if needed

Agent team: Researcher R reads kith-store message.rs and DeliveryState. Implementer I writes PeerReceiptArgs struct + ReceiptHandler. Tester T derives expected state transitions from kith-architecture.md. Validator V runs cargo test + clippy.

Tests (oracle = kith-architecture.md state machine):
- Happy path delivered: Peer/receipt kind=delivered for outgoing message -> deliveryState=Delivered in DB
- Happy path read: Peer/receipt kind=read -> readAt set in DB
- Wrong kind: kind="seen" -> JmapError::invalid_arguments
- Non-existent messageId -> JmapError::not_found
- messageId belongs to inbound message (delivery_state=Received): peer tries to receipt a message they sent us -> JmapError::not_found
- messageId belongs to different peer (wrong caller identity) -> JmapError::not_found
